reliefweb.summary: **KEY FIGURES** - 86M people across the region potentially exposed to El Niño impacts - 30M people at risk of humanitarian needs due to El Niño impacts - 1.8M people targeted for food assistance in Haiti still not receiving enough food **MEXICO: HURRICANE** Fuelled by abnormally warm waters owing to El Niño, Polo rapidly intensified from a tropical storm into a Category 5 hurricane on 22 September, registering the second-lowest pressure reported in the eastern Pacific. It struck Baja California Sur near Las Barrancas as a Category 2 hurricane late on 28 September, causing flooding and power outages, then made a second landfall near Guaymas, Sonora, in northwestern Mexico, as a Category 1 hurricane on 29 September.
